top_creatures.label: Halo-marked raid tier
top_creatures.why: A bone-anchored halo marks the top tier and reads at distance; scale is set per creature in data
top_creatures.keep: Halo only on the top tier, bone anchor, per-creature scale in data
top_creatures.change: Our own sigil ring and palette

top_creatures.label: Winged serpent boss (fastest row in the halo set, npc_speed about 2.86)

top_creatures.label: Stone golem line

looks.label: Gilt loot ground drop
looks.technique: Drop mesh shader clips dark texels (clip below a low threshold) so only gilt pixels read on the ground

looks.label: Raid-boss halo
looks.technique: Bone-anchored deco emitter, scale per row, halo_a and halo_b variants

looks.label: Feet glow or head ring
looks.technique: One height field on the deco actor: feet ground glow or head ring; bone attach else root

looks.label: Despawn fade
looks.technique: Alpha modifier from 255 to 0 over 2 s on despawn, no shader change

looks.label: Crystal reflection on ice effects
looks.technique: Environment cube plus specular mask on ice effect shaders

looks.label: Batched nameplates
looks.technique: All nicknames drawn in one overlay queue, one draw call

looks.label: Weapon effect slot and sword glow
looks.technique: Weapon row effect field (NSpear) on 4 rows; sword-sharpening glow as example effect

looks.label: Fire and glow skill effect
looks.technique: Glow textures and haze material on a fire effect folder

originals.name: Rank halo boss tier
originals.idea: A bone-anchored ring that marks only the top tier, scale set per creature in data (parity row 7)
originals.keep: Bone anchor, per-creature scale, top tier only

originals.name: Gilt loot ground
originals.idea: A loot mesh whose dark texels are clipped so only gilt pixels read on the ground (parity row 18)

originals.name: Dissolve on despawn
originals.idea: A 2-second alpha fade when a creature despawns on an empty zone (parity row 23)

originals.name: Hour-of-day zone mood table
originals.idea: Per-zone table of 288 samples for haze, cloud and light, read by the renderer (parity row 16)

originals.name: Three-type zone emitters
originals.idea: Day, night and always emitters with a radius and a random re-trigger (sound-music fold-in)

originals.name: Feet-or-head NPC deco
originals.idea: A deco that sits at the feet as a ground glow or at the head as a ring, chosen by one height field (parity rows 7 and 8)

originals.name: Friend aura versus enemy halo
originals.idea: A friendly helper gets an aura that never looks like a boss halo (parity row 14)

originals.name: Grade badge only when graded
originals.idea: A D-to-S badge in the tooltip, none shows no badge (parity row 15)

originals.name: Level HP curve
originals.idea: HP rises about 27x from the first band to the 71-80 band (parity rows 21 and 18)
